comments.author: ZarethKn
comments.body: Noticed her asking for help in North Sea. But I think she's found in a lot of places.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Marceline is among the first "wave" of Rescue Aides; they can appear randomly anywhere in the world that other Rescue NPCs do. The second wave (Alejandro, et. al) are the ones who only appear in certain sea regions.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: To add to that: If you're in a hurry to find this aide, my best advice is to try the Balearic Islands, Open Sea zone -- it is the smallest sea that NPCs can spawn in, and you can tell immediately if any are present. Just sail between the ocean zones east/west or west/east until a Rescue icon appears. Hope you get the aide you want soon! Cheers.
